ecfr_full_text.note: --compressed is mandatory or the endpoint returns HTTP 406

ecfr_versions.note: silently truncates at 1000 records while reporting the true count in meta.result_count; paginate with page=N, per_page is rejected. amendment_date clusters on a 2016-17 baseline load and is a floor, not history

ecfr_structure.used_for: subpart and subject-group nesting, and current reserved status

caveats: Every share is of the covered set (35% of Title 12, 33% of Title 29), not of the title. Sections without their own source note inherit one from their part, and inherited notes sit under actively amended parts, so all old-section counts are floors.
The Interpretations subject-group label is a Title 12 convention: 12 groups there, 1 in Title 29. A detector keyed on it returns near-zero elsewhere without erroring.
Settled is a candidate list, not a verified one. What a section's undated siblings did is unknowable by construction.
